title: Kopitiam Talk
description: Kaypoh, suaku, chope-level kiasu — the slang that makes your Mandarin sound homegrown.

example.zh: 头家 今天 请 大家 吃饭。
example.en: The boss is treating everyone to a meal today.

example.zh: 阿兵哥 星期五 回家。
example.en: The army boys go home on Friday.

example.zh: 不 要 那么 鸡婆！
example.en: Don't be so kaypoh!

items.note: Literally "mountain tortoise" — someone who hasn't seen the world.

example.zh: 你 没 去 过 星耀樟宜？ 真 山龟！
example.en: You've never been to Jewel? So suaku!

items.note: The stereotypical flashy, loud guy and girl.

example.zh: 他们 打扮 得 像 阿明阿莲。
example.en: They're dressed like Ah Beng and Ah Lian.

example.zh: 千万 不 要 跟 大耳窿 借钱！
example.en: Never borrow from a loan shark!

example.zh: 放心， 我 明天 搞掂。
example.en: Don't worry, I'll get it done tomorrow.

example.zh: 他 又 在 吃蛇 了。
example.en: He's skiving again.

example.zh: 年底 我们 去 日本 吃风。
example.en: We're holidaying in Japan at the end of the year.

example.zh: 他们 拍拖 三 年 了。
example.en: They've been dating for three years.

example.zh: 你 在 哪里 做工？
example.en: Where do you work?

example.zh: 我 可以 隆帮 你 的 车 吗？
example.en: Can I hitch a ride in your car?

example.zh: 你 的 华语 一级棒！
example.en: Your Mandarin is first-class!

items.english: to have it good (lucky in life)

example.zh: 他 真 好命， 不 用 加班。
example.en: He's so lucky — no overtime.

items.note: Like the tea, but here it means a muddle.

example.zh: 我 搞 乌龙 了， 去 错 地方。
example.en: I messed up and went to the wrong place.

example.zh: 这个 饭 臭酸 了， 不 要 吃。
example.en: This rice has gone sour — don't eat it.

example.zh: 不 要 听 他 的 骗话。
example.en: Don't listen to his lies.

example.zh: 敢敢 去 问 她！
example.en: Just go and ask her!

items.note: A sound-loan from English "percent". Note the order: 二十巴仙 = 20%.

example.zh: 今天 打折 二十 巴仙。
example.en: 20 percent off today.

example.zh: 打底 要 等 一个 小时。
example.en: We'll have to wait an hour at least.

example.zh: 我 一次过 付钱。
example.en: I'll pay it all at once.

example.zh: 他 一路来 都 很 准时。
example.en: He's always been punctual.

example.zh: 这 个 假期 头尾 五天。
example.en: This holiday is five days from start to finish.

example.zh: 机会 是 五十对五十。
example.en: The chances are fifty-fifty.

example.zh: 今天 是 你 的 大日子！
example.en: Today's your big day!

items.note: A "red bomb" — because it means you'll be giving a big red packet.

example.zh: 这 个 月 收到 三 个 红色炸弹。
example.en: Got three wedding invitations this month.

items.note: Shouted together at wedding dinners — hold the "seng" as long as you can.

example.zh: 大家 一起 饮胜！
example.en: Everyone, yum seng!

example.zh: 周末 在 公寓 有 烧烤会。
example.en: There's a barbecue at the condo this weekend.

example.zh: 我 在 跳蚤市场 买 了 旧 书。
example.en: I bought old books at the flea market.

items.note: The neighbourly, help-each-other spirit of old village life.

example.zh: 邻居 互相 帮忙， 这 就是 甘榜精神。
example.en: Neighbours helping each other — that's kampung spirit.

example.zh: 爷爷 小时候 住 在 甘榜。
example.en: Grandpa lived in a kampung as a child.

items.note: Literally "red hair". Casual — use with care.

example.zh: 那个 红毛 会 说 华语！
example.en: That ang mo can speak Mandarin!

example.zh: 给 你 一些 学 华语 的 贴士。
example.en: Here are some tips for learning Mandarin.

items.note: Old Singapore Chinese "went down" to the town centre, 坡底.

example.zh: 我们 下坡 买 东西。
example.en: We're going to town to shop.

example.zh: 她 一直 对 你 放电！
example.en: She keeps making eyes at you!

example.zh: 他 去 海边 吃冰淇淋。
example.en: He went to the beach to check out the eye candy.
